correctness.rationale: The exact-two condition forces all pairwise center distances to be positive even and <=4, yielding exactly eight coordinate profiles after XOR normalization. For three centers with disagreement sizes (a,b,c) and A common-zero positions, the linear constraints i+j+l+r=2, j+r=(a+c)/2 and l+r=(b+c)/2 give J=n-2,4,3,1 in the four profile classes. Multinomial counts summed over all first centers and divided by six produce precisely 2^n*[C(n,3),3C(n,4),10C(n,5),15C(n,6)] unordered triples; coincident exponents combine. For n=3 maximum one, n=4,5 maximum four, n=6 tie at four, n>=7 maximum n-2. Exactly max J distinct outputs can leave three candidates, so max J+1 threshold sharp. Positive mass ~n^6/(8*4^n). Independent brute-force n=3..6 enumerated all triples from actual sphere masks, reproducing histograms (n=6 positive J counts 960,3840,4160 at J=1,3,4). Finite checks are not the all-n proof.
